nodes.klein: to steal, rob, cheat, delude. he stole, he robbed; he cheated, deceived, deluded. was stolen. he stole frequently, was a habitual thief; he slipped in, he slipped out. he was stolen, it was stolen. he slipped in. he passed on stealthily, he introduced surreptitiously, he smuggled in. he was passed on stealthily, he was smuggled in.

nodes.g: to be put or thrust in or into a corner, be hidden from view, be cornered, be thrust aside
